text: This report recommends the appointment of 7 public members to the Toronto Preservation Board for a four-year term of office.

City Council on July 16, 17 and 18, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint the following candidates to the Toronto Preservation Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term office ending July 18, 2023, and until successors are appointed: Robert Allsopp Geoff Kettel Barbara McPhail Loryssa Quattrociocchi Julia Rady Sandra Shaul Kim Storey 2. City Council direct that the balance of Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 21, 2019) from the City Clerk remain confidential as it relates to personal information about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Preservation Board.
